concerns.text: FR-009 requires reporting odds ratios for individual metabolic traits (BMI, glucose, etc.) alongside gene‑expression odds ratios in the logistic regression output. However, FR-005 defines the logistic regression model as `MetS ~ gene_expression + age + sex + tissue + PMI + Time_of_Death + batch` (plus a severity score) and does not include the metabolic traits as predictors. Reporting odds ratios for traits that are not part of the model is contradictory, creating a circular validation issue.
